title: רגע של משפט
description: פודקאסט יומי על פסיקה אזרחית, מסחרית ודיני ראיות מהיממה האחרונה, בטון יבש וברצינות מופרזת. עמרי ומיכל מביאים כל בוקר שתי החלטות: אחת דיונית או ראייתית ואחת מהותית-מסחרית. הפודקאסט נכתב ומוקלט כולו בידי בינה מלאכותית, ואינו מהווה ייעוץ משפטי.
author: רגע של משפט

עמרי.anchor: Omri, always the same voice: a warm, articulate Jerusalem radio host in his early forties, smiling
עמרי.style: Warm, articulate radio voice of a Jerusalem law nerd: fluent and precise, in smooth, well-formed sentences; when something legal excites him his voice lights up with childlike enthusiasm. Endearing, a little pedantic, smiling. Lively but unhurried delivery. Natural Israeli Hebrew.

מיכל.anchor: Michal, always the same voice: a young Tel Aviv woman in her late twenties, giggly, warm and sharp-witted
מיכל.style: Young Tel Aviv woman, giggly, mischievous and cynical, with a sharp business mind. Casual, slangy and warm, at an easy, relaxed pace; cuts to the bottom line, teases her co-host and laughs easily, often mid-sentence. Natural Israeli Hebrew.

tts.pace: Pace: relaxed and unhurried, like a conversation over coffee, with natural pauses between sentences; lively in tone, never rushed.

script.note: Measured on 30.10 and 1.11.2026: with brisk directions Gemini Hebrew TTS spoke about 123 words per minute, and tempo 1.12 made it about 139, which the owner found too fast. Since 3.11 tempo is 1.0 and every turn carries tts.pace; expect about 105-115 words per minute, so 1,250 spoken words stay under 12 minutes.
